missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend overlapping nutrients until the full product label, serving frequency and other supplements are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume all multivitamins have the same composition.
Do not stack additional single-nutrient products without calculating total intake.
Do not treat a multivitamin as treatment for a diagnosed deficiency.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, chronic disease, renal/hepatic disease, medication interactions or known micronutrient deficiency requiring treatment.
population_and_context: People already taking a multivitamin/mineral product; overlapping micronutrients must be counted before recommending additional supplements.
dose_constraints: No additional dose from this rule. Reconcile each relevant nutrient across all products against life-stage reference values and upper limits.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral fact sheet notes product variability and limited evidence for broad prevention claims; label-level review is essential.
